definitions.gloss: variant form of a kanji character with the same reading and meaning
definitions.explanation: An alternate written form of a kanji that shares the same reading and meaning as the standard form but differs in stroke composition. Examples include 峯/峰 and 塚/塚. Commonly encountered in names and older texts.

examples.japanese: {峯|みね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{峰|みね}→峰：23001_mine⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{異体字|いたいじ}だ。
examples.english: 峯 is a variant form of 峰.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人名|じんめい}→人名：22206_jinmei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{異体字|いたいじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}っていない→載る：27882_noru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Variant characters used in personal names often don't appear in dictionaries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古文書|こもんじょ}→古文書：15839_komonjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{標準字体|ひょうじゅんじたい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧{異体字|いたいじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: Old documents contain many variant characters that differ from modern standard forms.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{旧字体|きゅうじたい}→旧字体：27161_kyuujitai⟧: old character form — the pre-1949 standard forms (e.g., {國|くに} for 国); a category of historical standard rather than variant
- {略字|りゃくじ}: simplified character — informal shorthand used in handwriting
- {異体字|いたいじ}: variant — a recognized alternate form, neither the modern standard nor purely informal

USAGE:
Commonly encountered when reading historical documents, Japanese personal names (人名用漢字 includes many), and place names. Digitally, may require special fonts or character selectors to display correctly.
